content.title: Atlanta Hawks vs Cleveland Cavaliers Live Stream: How to Watch NBA
content.text: The Cleveland Cavaliers look to take the season series lead and their fourth straight win when they host the Atlanta Hawks on Wednesday. The Atlanta Hawks look to solidify their position as the fifth seed in the Eastern Conference race when they travel to take on the Cleveland Cavaliers on Wednesday. The Cavaliers, meanwhile, are only a game back of the New York Knicks for third place. Atlanta is five games back of the fourth place Cavs coming into this matchup. New York has a tough matchup against the Boston Celtics on Thursday, so this is Cleveland’s chance to get ahead of the ball. This series is tied 1-1 against the Atlanta Hawks heading into Game 3 tonight, with the series finale on Friday in Atlanta. Atlanta won in a close 130-123 matchup in Game 2 at home on Nov. 28. Jalen Johnson put up a triple-double in that one, scoring 29 points, 12 rebounds and 12 assists. The Hawks overcame 42 points from Donovan Mitchell and shot 53 percent from the field. Cleveland goes for its fourth straight win tonight after already winning five of its last six games. Atlanta’s four-game winning streak came to an end on Monday, losing at home in a close one to the New York Knicks, 108-105. The Hawks nearly miraculously tied the game on a half-court shot from CJ McCollum. The shot went in, but it was ruled no good after review. Jalen Brunson hit two free throws with 1.2 seconds remaining to put the Knicks up three. New York won the season series 2-1, with Brunson scoring 30 points. But it was Nickeil Alexander-Walker who led all scorers with 36 points. It was just Atlanta’s first home loss since early February, ending its 13-game home winning streak. The Cavs are coming off a big 142-126 victory over the Memphis Grizzlies on the road on Monday. Evan Mobley scored 24 points to lead Cleveland, and Dennis Schroder added 22 points and 11 assists. The biggest headline of the night, though, was that the Grizzlies tied the NBA single game record for three-pointers with 29. They put up 59 and shot just under 50 percent. Still, it wasn’t enough to avoid getting swept by Cleveland in the season series. What Time Is the Atlanta vs Cleveland Game On?
